skills.name: Weighted-average share schedule

skills.need: Opening ordinary shares, issue or repurchase dates, daily share ledger, period length and profit attributable to ordinary holders.

steps: Separate ordinary shares outstanding from treasury shares; collect opening balance and every issue or cancellation date.
For each unchanged-share interval, multiply shares by days divided by total period days; sum the interval contributions and reconcile the closing ledger.
Use profit attributable to ordinary holders after relevant preference distributions; divide by weighted shares, then test a changed transaction date.
checks: Interval day fractions add to one and every transaction appears once.
Closing outstanding shares reconcile to the filing; the weighted denominator lies within the observed range.
